preconditions.description: Contract must have BNB balance (from accumulated fees) or ERC20 tokens from other users

exploit_hint: Call the unprotected clearStuckBNB() function to drain all BNB from the contract to the attacker's address. The function lacks proper access control (only checks _msgSender() == _msgSender(), which is always true). Also call recoverTokens() with any ERC20 token address to drain tokens from the contract.
